
                    ---    Star   ---&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;A Star grants you invincibility to everything except falling into a gap.&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;You can run on or through enemies with a star.&lt;br/&gt;
                 ---    Eato   ---&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;They are small plant-like creatures that will bite you on contact.&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;They do not move, but are sometimes placed in inconvenient locations.&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;Run with a Star through the Eatos to the right.&lt;br/&gt;
                 ---   Exit   ---&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;The tutorial ends if you press up at the door which is the level exit.&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;Start the Adventure now and explore the worlds. Have fun!&lt;br/&gt;
                ---    Flyon   ---&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;Some pipes, like the green one below, contain strange plant beasts that will come out and try to bite you.&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;If you block the exit while Flyon is in the pipe he can not see the exit and will stay inside.&lt;br/&gt;
               ---    Furball   ---&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;The two walking creatures you see below can be hit by stomping on top of their head.&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;He just walks forward in a straight line.&lt;br/&gt;
              ---   Army   ---&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;If you jump on them once they move into their shell and you can take the shell and throw it against other enemies or blocks.&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;Be careful because a moving shell can hit you too.&lt;br/&gt;If the shell stands still for a while he will move out of it.&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;
              ---   Gee   ---&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;This enemy that floats over the abyss flies around the area but stops shortly where you can hit them easily.&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;
              ---   Rokko   ---&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;The enemy that flies below here appears if Maryo comes close to them.&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;You can hit it by jumping on the top. They are immune to fire and ice.&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;If you have a star, you can ride them.&lt;br/&gt;
             --  New Text Box --&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;Bla blabla  BLA!&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;with word wrap : blabalabalalabaabababallaaaaaa ... bla ?&lt;br/&gt; BLAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA o.0&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;1234567890 #+.,?!&lt;&gt;|;:&apos;*&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;text1&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;text2&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;text3&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;text 2007 DX&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;SMC 1.0 !!!!!!!!!!!!!!111one!2!!!!&lt;br/&gt;
             ---    Ice Blocks   ---&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;Maryo slips on these, so be careful not to fall off the edge.&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;
            ---    Enemies   ---&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;Most enemies can be hit through jumping on their head like the hairy Furball on the ground but not the plant which jumps out of the pipe.&lt;br/&gt;
            ---    Fireplant   ---&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;This powerup will give you the power of fire, and allows you to throw fireballs.&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;Different types of enemies can be hit by fire.&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;         ---    Ice Mushroom   ---&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;The ice-blue mushroom will give you the power to throw iceballs at enemies.&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;Iceballs can only hit certain enemies, some enemies have a resistance to iceballs.&lt;br/&gt;
            ---    High Jump   ---&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;To overcome large spaces press the Run key all the time and jump on the last moment.&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;If you want to stop the jump early release the jump button.&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;
            ---    Power Jump   ---&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;You can reach the next platform with a power jump, press down till stars come from your feet and jump.&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;
           ---    Power Jump   ---&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;Reach the pipe platform with a power jump.&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;First you need to duck and wait for stars to appear on your shoes, then while still ducking jump.&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;Default keyboard shortcuts :&lt;br/&gt;Down to duck, s to jump, and hold a to jump higher.&lt;br/&gt;
          ---    Climbable plant   ---&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;There are a few objects which can be climbed by pressing up, down, right or left.&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;You can climb faster by pressing a.&lt;br/&gt;
          ---    Red Mushroom   ---&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;You found a red mushroom powerup which makes you grow bigger.&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;When big, you can be hit once from an enemy without dying. You cannot survive a fall into a gap, however.&lt;br/&gt;
          ---    Static Enemy   ---&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;There are many types of static enemies and they rarely move, but can become dangerous when they are in your path.&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;Be wary and watch where you step.&lt;br/&gt;
          ---   Savegames   ---&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;You can always save on the world but in a level you need 3000 points.&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;Save before running into difficult passages.&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;If you need more points find all the Waffles, Powerups and the secret areas.&lt;br/&gt;
         ---    Ghost Mushroom   ---&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;The grey transparent mushroom that is in the little alcove transforms you temporarily into a ghost.&lt;br/&gt;You see the hidden ghost blocks with it and enemies will not see you anymore.&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;The ghost state runs out after a short while, so watch out not to fall from ghost blocks.&lt;br/&gt;
         ---   Falling Platform   ---&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;After some time they will start shaking and fall down.&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;Try to cross this abyss and if you did not make it take the green pipe below.&lt;br/&gt;
         ---   Transport Pipes   ---&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;Some pipes can transport you to another pipe somewhere else in the level or even into another level.&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;Use a pipe by moving into its direction, on this pipe press down.&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;
        ---    Green Mushroom   ---&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;This mushroom will give you an extra life. Useful but hard to find.&lt;br/&gt;
        ---    Poison Mushroom   ---&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;The slimy poison mushroom is NOT good and if you eat one you will lose your powerup but when small, you lose a life.&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;
       ---   Moving Platform   ---&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;Ride the platform you see to the right and jump to the next ones to reach the exit.&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;Some platforms start only moving once you touch them.&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;Platforms can be halfmassive where pressing down causes you to fall through it instead of ducking.&lt;br/&gt;
#1 - Big Furball On The Mountain&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;At the top of the mountain is a big Furball. He&apos;s... huge. Defeat him to complete this objective.&lt;br/&gt;
#2 - Fall into the caged exit&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;Wait here. A lift will come shortly. Somewhere under this lift is an exit. Drop into it to complete this objective.&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;Warning! It&apos;s a long way down.&lt;br/&gt;
#3 - Secret of the Mountainside&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;Psst. Somewhere up the mountain is a secret door. Find it and  complete its challenge for another exit.&lt;br/&gt;
#4 - Bubbly Clouds, Red Coins&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;There are 8 red coins hidden in the clouds. Try to find them all...&lt;br/&gt;
#5 - Puzzling Pipes&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;Can you solve the mystery of the warping pipes?&lt;br/&gt;
#6 - Ghostly Dash to the finish&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;In the next box is a ghost mushroom. When you grab it, run. You must reach the goal before it runs out...&lt;br/&gt;
#7 - 100 Coins&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;There&apos;s a secret objective. Try to collect 100 Gold or red coins to clear. Note your coin total now and when it reaches the same value again, congratulations! You&apos;ve cleared the final objective.&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;NOTE: There is no exit for this objective. Once you&apos;ve collected the coins, find another exit.&lt;br/&gt;
&lt;br/&gt;
&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;HINT: Blue will always lead you to safety but not always to where you want to go.&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;Choose other colors to your risk or reward!&lt;br/&gt;
&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;A cave can be a dangerous place, but is often full of surprises.&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;Beware the pipes! They may lead to hidden treasure or sudden death!&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;But if you look hard enough, one may even lead you to your final destination.&lt;br/&gt;
&lt;br/&gt;A cave can be a dangerous place, but is often full of surprises.&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;Beware the pipes! They may lead to hidden treasure or sudden death!&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;But if you look hard enough, one may even lead you to your final destination.&lt;br/&gt;

There are no extras!!!&lt;br/&gt;
There&apos;s something special on the snowman!&lt;br/&gt;
This is a Tendrill, a climbing plant. Jump on it and press &quot;up&quot;, &quot;down&quot;, &quot;right&quot;, or &quot;left&quot; to climb on it.&lt;br/&gt;To jump off a climbable object press &quot;Alt&quot;!  This way it is possible to reach hidden areas or a place, from which you come forth in the level. Climb this one and find out!&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;Unreachable goldpieces left to me?&lt;br/&gt;No, not really. Climb the climbable beanstalk to collect them in! &lt;br/&gt;
This is a climbable vine.&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;Climb it with the up and down key and get off it with the jump key or climb away from it.&lt;br/&gt;
This is a teleport, you can warp everywhere, in a dangerous place too!&lt;br/&gt;
This stutters every second using vsync in windowed mode on an &lt;br/&gt;ATI 3870 card (10.4 driver)&lt;br/&gt;ATI 4850 card (10.9 driver)&lt;br/&gt;ATI 5770 card (10.11 driver)&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;but not on fullscreen.&lt;br/&gt;&lt;br/&gt;Nvidia/Intel cards not tested.&lt;br/&gt;
